website.title: Make your business easy to choose.
website.summary: Tell us what customers need to find, understand, or do. We’ll look at the path and send a clear next step.
website.messageLabel: What should your website make easier?
website.placeholder: For example: customers cannot tell what we do, we need a first website, or booking is hard to find.

support.title: Get your day moving again.
support.summary: Tell us what stopped working or keeps slowing everyone down. We’ll help name the next useful move.
support.placeholder: For example: our Wi-Fi drops, the register is unreliable, or we cannot get into an account.

consulting.title: Make a confident next move.
consulting.summary: Tell us what needs a clear decision before you change it. We’ll help map the next useful move.
consulting.placeholder: For example: we are choosing a new tool, our customer handoffs are messy, or we need to know what to keep.

systems.title: Plan software that fits your business.
systems.summary: Tell us where a repeated handoff breaks down. We’ll help decide whether to keep, connect, replace, or build.
systems.placeholder: For example: staff copy the same information between tools, a client handoff gets lost, or a repeat job needs a simpler system.

general.title: Get a clear next step.
general.summary: Tell us what you want to improve or fix. Website, social page, everyday tools, or something broken. We’ll tell you what to keep, change, or leave alone.
general.messageLabel: What would you like to improve or fix?
general.placeholder: For example: We have no website yet and customers find us on Instagram, we need online booking, or a tool is slowing us down.
